claims.text: Lake Titicaca is shared by Peru and Bolivia.
Chile, Ecuador and Argentina have no shore on Lake Titicaca.
On the Peruvian side of Lake Titicaca, the Uros people live on floating islands made of totora reeds.
The Uros keep their islands afloat by adding fresh reeds on top as the lower layers rot.
